questions.question:
Select the most appropriate synonym to substitute the bracketed word in the given sentence.

Spreading from the ports, Formosan termites began a (subterranean) colonization of the country.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is "**Underground**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let us understand the meaning of the given and the marked words:
 
 
• **The word "subterranean" means underground.**(भूमि के भीतर का)
 
• It is used to describe something that is situated, occurring, or operating beneath the surface of the earth.
 
 
 
• In the given sentence, it refers to the colonization of the country by Formosan termites that started underground, from the ports.
 
 
• **"Underground" means under the surface of the ground.** (भूमिगत)
 
 
• Example: The underground sewage system of the Harappan civilization is the best example of their town planning.
 
 
 
 
 
• Thus, it is clear that the word "underground" is the synonym of the word "subterranean."

Hence, **the correct answer is option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1 (Overt) means done or shown openly; not secret or hidden.(अपरोक्ष)
 
• Option 3 (Subcutaneous) means situated or applied under the skin.(चमड़े के नीचे का)
 
• Option 4 (Terrestrial) means relating to the earth or to land; worldly.(पार्थिव)

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate antonym to substitute the bracketed word in the given sentence.

For high-moisture areas, like kitchens and baths or where (frequent) cleaning is required, use only oil-based.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is "**seldom**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let us understand the meaning of the given and the marked words:
 
 
• **"Frequent" means something that happens often. **(प्रायः घटित होने वाला)

 
 
• Example: She visits the temple very frequently.
 
 
 
• **Antonym of "frequent" is "seldom", meaning not happening often.**(कदाचित)
 
 
• Example: She seldom goes to the temple.
 
 
 
 
 
• The sentence suggests that oil-based products should be used in areas that don't require frequent cleaning, hence the opposite would be true for high-moisture areas that do require frequent cleaning.

​Hence, **the correct answer is option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1, "constant", means happening continuously or all the time, which is not the opposite of "frequent".(स्थिर)
 
• Option 2, "confirmed", means verified or established as true, which is not the opposite of "frequent".(स्थायी)
 
• Option 3, "dawdle", means to waste time or move slowly, which is not the opposite of "frequent".(धीरे-धीरे आगे बढ़ना)

questions.question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank No. 5.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is "**though**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The passage describes a state of chaos. On the other hand blank 5 will imply the contradictory point of how Mansi was waiting for this.**
 
• **Among the given options, the correct conjunction to use is "though."**
 
 
• "Though" is a conjunction that is used to introduce a contrast or concession.(हलांकि)
 
• It is often used to show a contrast between two ideas or to acknowledge a difficult or contradictory situation.
 
• In this case the contrast is between the state of chaos and Mansi's intentions.
 
 
• Example: "Though I am tired, I will still go to the gym."
 
 
 
 

Hence, **the correct answer is option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• "Like" is a preposition that is used to show similarity or comparison.(जैसा)
 
• "Throughout" is an adverb that means from beginning to end or all the way through.(लगातार)
 
• "Through" is a preposition that can mean movement in a particular direction or passage from one side to another.(के माध्यम से)
